PRACTICE AREAS

How we can help

We act for individuals and businesses, from advice and out-of-court settlement to representation in court.

Family law

Uncontested and contested divorce, custody, contact and child maintenance.

Learn more

Inheritance law

Wills, accepting or renouncing an inheritance, certificates of inheritance and estate division.

Learn more

Real estate & leases

Title checks, purchases and sales, leases and evictions. Including buyers from abroad.

Learn more

Corporate & commercial law

Company formation, articles of association, commercial contracts and shareholder agreements.

Learn more

Employment law

Dismissals, severance and employment contracts, for employees and employers.

Learn more

Debt recovery

Formal demands, payment orders and enforcement for unpaid invoices.

Learn more

HOW WE START

From first contact to engagement

  1. Tell us about your matter

    By phone or through the form. We reply within one working day.

  2. First meeting

    At our office or by video call. We assess your matter and explain your options.

  3. Written proposal

    You receive the next steps, timeline and fee in writing before you decide.

OUR APPROACH

What you can expect from us

Confidentiality

Everything you share is protected by legal privilege, from the very first contact.

Plain language

We explain legal issues without jargon, so you can decide with the full picture.

Updates at every step

You always know where your matter stands and what happens next.

Clients abroad, too

We work in English and remotely, using a power of attorney where needed.
